content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the all-new Valet accessory, describing it as a "wireless charging stand and personal catchall tray."

Now, Twelve South is expanding the Valet lineup with a more compact version that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The original Valet announced earlier this year measures 7.5 inches, providing enough space to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and other items. However, the new Valet has been significantly reduced in size to just 4.25 inches.

Here is Twelve South's description of Valet's exceptional design:

Valet is first and foremost a beautiful home accessory, and secondarily a sophisticated wireless charger. It combines warm materials with modern craftsmanship to create a calmer, more intentional silhouette suitable for anywhere in the home—from entryway tables and kitchens to nightstands. The soft, square charging pad complements the architectural lines of the leather tray, while the weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything firmly in place and beautifully organized.

In terms of functionality, the more compact Valet also has ample power to charge an iPhone, and includes an additional USB-C port for conveniently charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather catchall
  • Four configurable placement modes
  • Removable leather bezel
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with built-in hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port providing up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes a 45W power supply and 1.5-meter USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available for order starting today at $129.99, offered in three different color combinations. It's not cheap, but it is indeed an elegant place to charge your phone while resting your glasses, wallet, or keys.
